title: PROMO-05 — Quality pass: script tone tuning, image timing polish, Stripe per-video billing
rationale: TICKET-008 P1-PROMO Sprint 5/5. Tune promo-scriptgen prompt (hook/CTA). Add promo-credits.ts (Stripe payment link on 0 credits, free tier=1 video). Wire credit gate into promo-command.ts. tasks.description: Improve promo-scriptgen.ts system prompt: add hook strength criteria (bold claim, question, or shocking stat), CTA must include action verb + urgency. Add beat-level quality hints to BEAT_GUIDE.
Create scripts/promo/promo-credits.ts — credit balance (workspace/promo-credits/{userId}.json), init free tier (1 credit), deduct on completion, generate Stripe Payment Link when balance=0.
Wire credit gate into agents/telegram-bot/promo-command.ts: check credits before run, deduct after success, send payment link message when 0.
Create scripts/promo/score-promo.ts — scores a script.json: hook strength (0-100), CTA clarity (0-100), avg score. Outputs PASS if avg>=70.
